summary_1line: Amid chaotic battle, Arjuna devastates Kaurava forces while Bhishma counterattacks, and both armies fight indiscriminately seeking glory and heaven.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna standing on his chariot with the ape-banner, releasing countless arrows from the radiant Gandiva as enemy warriors fall around him.
The battlefield carpeted with slain warriors, broken chariots, elephants, and red-stained earth while vultures and jackals gather.
Bhishma charging forward invoking a blazing celestial weapon as Sikhandin rushes to intercept him before Arjuna.
